notes.title: Add Wall Run feature. Enjoy it.
notes.notes:
Add Wall Run feature.
minor map bug fix

The Wall Run feature conflicts slightly with the Double Jump and Ledge Climb features. 
So it takes some getting used to. 
By default, this feature is off. To turn it on, press Alt + W.
